_meta.description: Outcome archetypes for cooking. Each recipe in recipes.json references an outcome_id here. Many recipes -> one outcome (e.g. rat kidney and kobold kidney sauteed with mushroom both give small_recovery_perception). Buff types are canonical status_effects (see src/status_effects.py:BUFFS). temp_amount is buff-specific magnitude (interpreted by add_effect). temp_duration is turns. Trophies (T5) fire permanent_power via _apply_permanent_power in food_system.py. Phase-1 cook expansion (2026-10-03): 115 multi-ingredient archetypes appended (30 two-ing / 40 three-ing / 25 four-ing / 20 five-ing).
_meta.buff_semantics: temp_power = status_effects.BUFFS name; temp_duration = turns; permanent_power = key into _apply_permanent_power dispatcher (preserved from v2.6.3).
_meta.tier_bands: T1: SP 30-50, HP 0-6, 30t buff, no perm bonus. T2: SP 50-75, HP 4-10, 60t buff. T3: SP 75-110, HP 8-15, 80t buff + occasional +1 max HP. T4: SP 100-135, HP 12-20, 100t strong buff + +2 max HP + occasional +1 stat. T5 non-trophy: SP 130-160, HP 18-25, 120t big buff + +3 max HP + +1 stat. T5 trophy: unique per-boss + permanent_power.

_comments._comment_t1: TIER 1 — early-game (ml 1-15) — light snacks, quick refills, small buffs
_comments._comment_t2: TIER 2 — mid-early (ml 15-35) — proper dishes, meaningful buffs, family-tier meals
_comments._comment_t3: TIER 3 — deep (ml 35-55) — real fortification, meaningful +max HP, strong buffs
_comments._comment_t4: TIER 4 — very deep (ml 55-80) — near-endgame; +2 max HP baseline, +1 stat on some, 100t strong buffs
_comments._comment_t5nt: TIER 5 non-trophy — apex meals (ml 80+, non-boss primes) — +3 max HP + +1 stat + strong buff
_comments._comment_t5trophy: TIER 5 TROPHY — one per boss (14 total). Each preserves the existing permanent_power dispatcher (_apply_permanent_power in food_system.py).
